what: The release history. The first entry is the current version; the build writes it into every page's footer and llms.txt, and the gate fails if any of them disagree.

versions.title: A redesign to match the rest of the network, and a finder that works like a repo picker: type, the best match is already highlighted, arrows move, Enter opens
changes: assets/site.css: the network's teal palette and serif headings, light and dark; a sticky header with the part-of-sgit.ai pill, version chip, Search and GitHub buttons; a centred home hero

assets/finder.js: type-ahead over findings, principles, exemplars and pages, on the home page and as a palette from any page (Search button, / or Ctrl/Cmd+K); no JavaScript still means a plain search form and link

assets/findings.js: the nine dropdowns are now behind one filters button with an active-count badge; one search field first, one-tap chips (Open, High severity, Fixed, Failures, Gaps), best title match first, matches highlighted, arrow keys and Enter, a copy-link button
assets/search.json: the type-ahead index, generated by the build so it cannot list what does not exist
content/index.md: the home page lists five high-severity findings rather than sixteen (the same overload UX-002 reports), with a link to the rest; the search field is on the first screen
admin/build/build.py: the {{finder}} and {{quick}} directives, a limit option on {{findings-list}}, the new header and footer

versions.title: Voice input that can throw away your words: four findings on the Claude app's dictation controls, one thing it gets right, and two principles about lost work and silent systems
changes: data/findings.json: UX-060 (X discards the recording without confirmation), UX-061 (three unlabelled controls), UX-062 (silent second-pass rewrite), UX-063 (live transcript stalls with no state shown), with a screenshot
data/exemplars.json: EX-002, the live transcript as proof the recording is working
data/principles.json: work is never lost to one tap or a silent failure; the reader can always tell what the system is doing
data/taxonomy.json: problem "missing feedback"; recommendations "confirm or undo", "show the state", "show what changed"
data/site.json: the Claude app product covers iPhone and iPad; new area: input and dictation
content/admin/index.md: releases bump the patch number

versions.title: A security prompt that asks for a decision it does not explain: UX-059, and a principle for informed decisions
changes: data/findings.json: UX-059, the Claude app's Bash permission prompt shows raw, truncated code and no plain-words summary, with a screenshot
data/principles.json: new principle, a decision comes with what you need to make it
data/taxonomy.json: problem "uninformed decision", recommendation "explain the decision"
data/site.json: Claude app on iPhone added as a product (type: app); new area: security decisions

versions.title: What good looks like: exemplars join the register, starting with Safari on iPad, and a principle for interfaces that can be learned
changes: data/exemplars.json + /exemplars/: EX-001, Safari on iPad collapses its toolbars after a small scroll at any speed; answers UX-057 and UX-058
data/principles.json: new principle, the same gesture gives the same result, so it can be learned; UX-058 moved to it
data/site.json: Safari on iPad added as a product
Finding pages link the exemplars that answer them; principle sections link the exemplars that demonstrate them; the gate checks exemplars

versions.title: Hiding Firefox's toolbars on an iPad depends on the speed of the flick, so the reader cannot choose it; and three newsroom findings re-checked from a reader's screenshots
changes: data/findings.json: UX-058 (toolbar state depends on gesture speed) with two screenshots in findings/img/; UX-057 points to it
data/findings.json: UX-003 and UX-004 fixed, UX-028 partly fixed, each re-checked on newsroom v0.12.120
data/taxonomy.json: new problem "unpredictable control" and recommendation "make it predictable"

versions.title: The register is indexed nine ways, and the first reports from readers arrive: two Firefox-on-iPad findings about a page that will not hold still
changes: data/taxonomy.json: problem (24), visibility (4) and recommendation (17) vocabularies; every existing finding backfilled
data/site.json: sites become products, with a type (site, platform, prototype, browser); Firefox on iPad added
data/findings.json: UX-056 (scroll up focuses the address bar and opens the keyboard) and UX-057 (toolbars return on any scroll up), with screenshots in findings/img/
data/principles.json: new principle, nothing moves that the reader did not move; UX-051 moved to it
content/browse/index.md: every facet with counts, each value a link to the filtered list
admin/build/: facets drive filters, finding pages, browse and llms.txt; the gate checks the taxonomy and evidence images

versions.title: The first release: a register of UX failures and gaps, seeded from the newsroom review, with the review, the design lab and the method it was made by
changes: data/findings.json: 55 findings (newsroom.sgit.ai, the vault host, and the lab's own prototypes), each with evidence, impact, fix, status and the principle it breaks
data/principles.json: 14 principles, each listing the findings that break it
content/reviews/newsroom-2026-10-11.md: the newsroom UX review of 11 October 2026, published whole
content/lab/index.md + lab/shots/: the Newsroom Design Lab, its four vaults with read keys, and 24 phone screenshots in three directions
content/method/index.md: the reader path, the panel, severity, and how a finding is filed
admin/build/: build.py, md.py and gate.py, stdlib only
